basePrompt:
Create a freshly drawn, coherent, professional character reference sheet of MIRA, the established adult fantasy healer character described below. This is a new illustration, NOT an edit, tracing, restoration, or rearrangement of an existing sheet. Landscape 3:2; maximum native resolution and precise detail. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, lettering, numbers, labels, title, logo, watermark, fake script, arrows with captions, or annotations.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Reference 1 (original older labeled reference sheet) is STYLE ONLY: delicate fine lines, softly painted color, calm desaturated palette, subtle luminous light, richly drawn hair and irises. Do not copy its figure poses, layout or malformed clothing. Do not inherit text or decorative page graphics.
Reference 2 (the latest text-free sheet with a large three-quarter portrait) is a comparison for the REQUESTED BODY CORRECTION and coherent chest garment concept ONLY. Her bust is too prominent in this image. Reduce breast volume by approximately one to two size steps, visibly smaller and modest. Do not repeat its poses or panel layout. No bust emphasis, no cleavage, no tight fabric outlining breasts.
Reference 3 (eight face icons) is the authoritative established MIRA face identity, hair/iris colors, eye drawing and subtle gray-lavender under-eye fatigue color. Keep the same face identity throughout.

CHARACTER SETTINGS OVERRIDE ANY CONTRADICTORY IMAGE:
Mira is an adult woman in her mid twenties, a gentle moon-themed healer who prioritizes other people's care over her own rest. Slender fine-boned build, modest small bust, natural consistent adult proportions. Long ash silver-lavender hair, lavender-gray eyes with intricately painted irises, delicate face, softly heavy upper eyelids. Very pale ivory skin. Subtle muted cool gray-lavender shadows beneath the lower eyelids show fatigue / poor blood color, NOT red/pink cheek blush, not makeup, not purple bruises. Match the face icons' softness and shade. She looks kind despite fatigue. Gentle restrained smile, attentive serious look, surprise opening the eyes distinctly, worried expression subtly drawn. No six copies of the same face.

FIXED HAIR DESIGN:
Long hair reaching roughly lower back / upper hip, airy fine fringe, two temple braids joined into a braided back arrangement, loose lower lengths. On the character's LEFT temple is ONE crescent moon ornament with ONE translucent pearly orb, THREE white flowers, ONE navy-lavender ribbon bow with two tails, and TWO slim gold star dangles. Mirror placement correctly between front and back views. Do not duplicate the crescent on both sides. Avoid adding other hair ornaments. Consistent hair length and braid construction in every view.

FIXED CLOTHING CONSTRUCTION:
A SINGLE opaque ivory sleeveless bodice, gently fitted with simple believable seams, smooth modest straight upper edge, continuous coverage over the chest and sternum to the waist. Bust distinctly 1–2 steps smaller than reference 2; natural small volume and relaxed fabric. TWO narrow ivory shoulder straps attached to the same bodice. Separate small ivory ruffled stand collar, ONE dark muted navy-lavender bow with ONE small gold star clasp at throat. Keep collar, bow, bodice, straps and outer robe clearly separable and physically coherent. No cleavage hole, sheer breast fabric, cutout, crossing random strips, doubled neckline or dangling fabric fragments.
Lightweight ivory open-front robe draped below the shoulders around the upper arms, pale dusty lavender-blue lining, restrained fine gold celestial border embroidery; continuous back and clear sleeve joins. Layered ivory skirt and long tapering outer robe panels, restrained gold trim, dark lavender ribbon at the character's RIGHT thigh. Dark brown open-toe ankle boots with paired straps and low/moderate heels.
ONE brown leather waist belt with simple antique-gold rectangular buckle at center front. TWO medicine pouches on the character's LEFT hip (one medium outer pouch and one small adjacent pouch); TWO small securely held glass medicine vials on the character's RIGHT hip. Every view must keep these positions, shapes and counts consistent. No proliferation of bags/belts/jewelry.

KEY ACCESSORIES:
Moon motif healing staff: slender dark shaft, gold crescent head, ONE pearly transparent orb nested inside the crescent, small cluster of THREE white flowers and TWO navy-lavender ribbon tails. Full staff must fit on canvas, same construction as enlarged study.
Practical healer's pouch detail: show a medium brown leather medicine pouch together with its small organized contents, rolled clean bandage, folded gauze, small scissors, two corked medicine bottles and a short bundle of medicinal herbs. It must read as a treatment kit, not just decorative jewelry or perfume. The previously unconfirmed pouch interior arrangement and concealed back fastenings are design proposals, not established canon.
For unconfirmed construction, minimize invention: show only known external back design in the main turnaround, avoid adding elaborate back fastenings. Put the OPEN pouch/interior suggestion alone in a small pale dotted-outline panel at bottom-right, separated from the solid-line confirmed reference studies. No words or legend inside image. This visual separation permits the accompanying message to identify the proposed detail.

REQUIRED CONTENT AND SPACIOUS NEW LAYOUT:
Use a bright plain off-white background, minimal decoration, no scattered flowers, crescent background motifs, star borders or decorative vines. Thin faint lavender panel rules if necessary; genuine white margins between drawings.
Left approximately 42%: THREE matching full-body figures, FRONT straight-on, strict SIDE profile, straight BACK, heads and feet completely visible with breathing room. Same scale and body proportions, relaxed neutral anatomical poses, readable garments. Front holds staff slightly away from torso; body silhouette and chest clearly visible. Staff must not obstruct costume.
Upper center/right: THREE generous head-and-shoulder views, FACE FRONT, strict PROFILE, 45-DEGREE three-quarter. Same character, exact facial identity, same modest body and consistent neckline.
Middle center/right: SIX clearly distinct expressive portraits in a 3 columns x 2 rows arrangement: neutral, slight smile, joy; serious, surprise, worried. All text-free. Consistent identity and ornaments.
Bottom across page: clean detailed enlarged studies with breathing room: braided hairstyle from rear; crescent hair ornament; torso clothing construction showing collar/bow/straps/bodice/outer robe/waist together; CLOSED healer pouch and attached vials; crescent staff head; ankle boot. Fit these tastefully without overcrowding.
Bottom-right small separated dotted-border study: proposed open treatment-kit pouch interior, no text.
An orderly unlabeled palette of about 10 solid swatches showing actual principal colors (hair, iris, pale skin, under-eye gray lavender, ivory cloth, lavender lining, navy ribbon, brown leather, muted gold). No pink cosmetic blush swatch.
All required views must be present, comfortably framed, and consistent. Do not substitute repeated front faces for profile views. No cropped heads, feet or staff.

ART DIRECTION:
Beautiful delicate fine-line Japanese fantasy character design, softly layered paint and luminous but controlled highlights, calm pale desaturated colors, detailed flowing individual hair strands and finely painted reflective eyes, crisp high-quality master with smooth shading and no blur or retake artifacts. Costume detail must remain legible, neither oversimplified nor covered in arbitrary gold ornaments. Smaller bust and internally consistent garment structure are essential.
Return ONE completed text-free reference sheet.
finalEditSummary: Preserve the complete text-free reference sheet. Strengthen the cool desaturated gray-lavender under-eye fatigue shadows by a modest visible step (requested approximately 25–35%), without pink cheek blush or bruise-like saturation. Reduce bust volume another modest visible step (requested approximately 20–25% less projection/fullness), especially in side view and torso details, keeping natural adult proportions and coherent opaque clothing. Apply both changes consistently across all figures and expressions. Preserve all other design, layout, accessories, palette and dotted-border proposed pouch-interior study. Percentages describe prompt intent, not measured output changes.
